essence: The divine figure is portrayed as wearing tiger skin and resplendent with complete ornamentation.
The figure may be depicted either in divine garments or wearing deer skin.
The divine figure is characterized by bearing a boar-tusk tip, tiger nails, and a tortoise.
The figure stands on the right foot while the left foot is positioned above and turned.
The figure’s eyes are directed like bees toward Ambika’s lotus-like face.
